caption: No script -- the same condition builder you already know.

code:
If/Else: [Priority] is [Critical]

  If branch (condition true):
    - Send urgent SMS to on-call engineer
    - Create escalation task

  Else branch (condition false):
    - Send standard email to assignment group
caption: The flow evaluates the condition once and commits to exactly one branch.
